text:
Maya Chen: quick async check — starting a canary for feature flag `ff/infer-rewrite-v2` now (2% traffic). No infra changes, just model routing + prompt tweak. Planning: hold 2% for 30m, then 10% for 30m, then ramp if metrics look good. pinging SRE + QA for visibility.

deploy-bot: created rollout id `rollout_2026_0032` · canary=2% · started at 2026-03-17T13:04:21Z · <https://dashboard.redwood/rollouts/rollout_2026_0032|open rollout>

Javier Ortiz: +1. I'll attach a temporary trace for latency p50/p95 and add an alert for p95 > 350ms on the canary slice. Also watching token billing spikes.

Li Wei: ran the smoke suite against the canary model variant on staging a few mins ago — all checks passed: generation integrated tests, output shape, and function calling. No obvious hallucination regressions on our sample prompts.

Sam Patel: confirmed no schema or DB changes. Routing config looks good. I pushed the ff rollout config: `rwctl feature set ff/infer-rewrite-v2 --percent 2 --rollout-id rollout_2026_0032`

Maya Chen: thanks Sam — can you post the exact rwctl status command we'll use to watch?

Sam Patel: sure — run:`
```
# check rollout status
rwctl feature status ff/infer-rewrite-v2 --rollout rollout_2026_0032 --format wide

# tail the canary logs (k8s pod names will be prefixed)
k logs -f deployment/infer-runtime-canary-2pct -n infra | grep rollout_2026_0032
```

Priya Rao: product ack — observing a small sample of user flows in staging looked better on relevance. If SRE sees any sign of increased error rates / timeouts, priority is rollback.

QA Bot: smoke results posted: <https://ci.redwood/prints/rollout_2026_0032/smoke> — 18/19 checks green, one intermittent tokenization edge-case flagged (long inputs). Marking as INFO, not blocking for canary, but please watch sampling.

Nikhil Rao: I'm on the watchlist. Will escalate to oncall if HTTP 5xx > 0.5% over 5m or lat p95 > 400ms. For now p50/p95 are stable. If QA's tokenization edge shows up in logs I'll pause the ramp.

Javier Ortiz: adding a short-run synthetic that sends longer prompts (300-500 tokens) to catch that tokenization issue — results in ~10m. Will post summary.

Maya Chen: noted. Plan: hold at 2% for 30m, if stable bump to 10% and run a second smoke. If any of these trigger conditions hit, we rollback using `rwctl rollout rollback rollout_2026_0032` and notify PLG/support.

deploy-bot: rollout `rollout_2026_0032` update · status=canary · slice=2% · monitors=[latency-p95, error-rate, tokenization-regression] · link=<https://dashboard.redwood/rollouts/rollout_2026_0032/health>

Li Wei: small note — the canary pods are on GPU pool group `dedicated-infer-03`. If we need more samples I can spin a temporary synthetic job there.

Sam Patel: leaving a bookmark: `#post-rollout-checks` in the rollout doc for actions at 10% and 50%.

Priya Rao: thanks team — I'll prepare the customer comms draft in case we need to roll back.

Maya Chen: excellent. if nobody objects, I'll start timer and we'll reconvene here in ~35m with status. @Nikhil Rao @Javier Ortiz @Li Wei @Sam Patel @Priya Rao

Javier Ortiz: watching. :eyes:

Nikhil Rao: watching, will call if thresholds breach.

(30m later)

Maya Chen: quick update — holding at 2% for 30m, no error spikes, p95 latency +0.03s vs baseline, QA intermittent tokenization seen in 3 of 2200 requests (0.14%). Proceeding to 10% ramp in 5m unless anyone objects.

Priya Rao: go for 10% from product side.

Sam Patel: initiated ramp: `rwctl feature set ff/infer-rewrite-v2 --percent 10 --rollout-id rollout_2026_0032`

deploy-bot: rollout `rollout_2026_0032` update · status=canary · slice=10% · started at 2026-03-17T13:40:10Z

QA Bot: running extended smoke on 10% slice, will report in ~12m.

Nikhil Rao: continuing to monitor; set uptimes and alerting thresholds. If error-rate > 0.3% on 10% slice we auto-pause and notify.

Maya Chen: thanks all — will post final wrap here after the 10% window.
